#!/bin/bash

. /etc/os-release
case $ID in
	ubuntu | debian )
		TYPE=deb
		;;
	* )
		TYPE=rpm
		;;
esac

while true
do
	datetime=$(date)
	echo "############################################"
	echo "#### $datetime ####"
	echo "############################################"

	### Get the system version
	system_version=$(cat /opt/maca/Version.txt)
	if [[ "$system_version" =~ Version\:[0-9]+\.[0-9]+ ]]; then
		#echo "Get System Version for release"
		system_version=$(echo "$system_version" | grep -Eo '[0-9]*\.[0-9]*\.[0-9]*\.[0-9]*')
	elif [[ "$system_version" =~ Version\:[0-9]+\-[0-9]+ ]]; then
		#echo "Get System Version for master"
		system_version=$(echo "$system_version" | grep -Eo '[0-9]*\-[0-9]*')
	fi

	version_all=$(cat /opt/maca/.version.txt)
	IFS=$'\n' read -d '' -ra version_all_lines <<< "$version_all"
	other_version_arr=()
	for version_all_line in "${version_all_lines[@]}"; do
		### Get the system mxgpu_llvm version
		if [[ $version_all_line =~ mxgpu_llvm\:[0-9]+\.[0-9]+ ]]; then
			mxgpu_llvm_version=$(echo "$version_all_line" | grep -Eo '[0-9]*\.[0-9]*\.[0-9]*\.[0-9]*')
			continue
		elif [[ $version_all_line =~ mxgpu_llvm\:[0-9]+\-[0-9]+ ]]; then
			mxgpu_llvm_version=$(echo "$version_all_line" | grep -Eo '[0-9]*\-[0-9]*')
			continue
		fi
		other_version_arr[${#other_version_arr[*]}]=$version_all_line
	done

	case $TYPE in
		deb )
			### get the vbios version
			vbios_version_num=$(dpkg -l | grep -o "mxfw binary deb package" | wc -l)
			if [[ $vbios_version_num == 1 ]]; then
				vbios_version=$(dpkg -l | grep "mxfw binary deb package")
				vbios_version=$(echo "$vbios_version" | grep -Eo '[0-9]*\.[0-9]*\.[0-9]*\.[0-9]*')
			else
				echo "Warning: Find more than 1 vbios packages, the metax driver may install with multi versions."
			fi

			### get the kmd version
			kmd_version_num=$(dpkg -l | grep -o metax-linux | wc -l)
			if [[ $kmd_version_num == 1 ]]; then
				kmd_version=$(dpkg -l | grep metax-linux)
				kmd_version=$(echo "$kmd_version" | grep -Eo '[0-9]*\.[0-9]*\.[0-9]*')
			else
				echo "Warning: Find more than 1 kmd packages, the metax driver may install with multi versions."
			fi
			;;
		*)
			### get the vbios version
			vbios_version_num=$(rpm -qa | grep -o "mxfw" | wc -l)
			if [[ $vbios_version_num == 1 ]]; then
				vbios_version=$(rpm -qa | grep "mxfw")
				vbios_version=$(echo "$vbios_version" | grep -Eo '[0-9]*\.[0-9]*\.[0-9]*\.[0-9]*')
			else
				echo "Warning: Find more than 1 vbios packages, the metax driver may install with multi versions."
			fi

			### get the kmd version
			kmd_version_num=$(rpm -qa | grep -o metax-linux | wc -l)
			if [[ $kmd_version_num == 1 ]]; then
				kmd_version=$(rpm -qa | grep metax-linux)
				kmd_version=$(echo "$kmd_version" | grep -Eo '[0-9]*\.[0-9]*\.[0-9]*')
			else
				echo "Warning: Find more than 1 kmd packages, the metax driver may install with multi versions."
			fi
			;;
	esac

	#echo "###########################################################################"
	#echo "#### Get the GPU BIOS version and compare with the System BIOS version ####"
	#echo "###########################################################################"
	vbios_version_multiline=$(mx-smi --show-version | grep BIOS)
	IFS=$'\n' read -d '' -ra vbios_version_lines <<< "$vbios_version_multiline"

	#echo "#########################################################################"
	#echo "#### Get the GPU KMD version and compare with the System KMD version ####"
	#echo "#########################################################################"
	kmd_version_multiline=`mx-smi --show-version | grep KMD`
	IFS=$'\n' read -d '' -ra kmd_version_lines <<< "$kmd_version_multiline"

	#echo "#########################################################################"
	#echo "#### Get the GPU SMI version and compare with the System SMI version ####"
	#echo "#########################################################################"
	smi_version_content=`mx-smi --show-version | grep smi`
	get_smi_version=$(echo "$smi_version_content" | grep -Eo '[0-9]*\.[0-9]*\.[0-9]*')

	i=0
	a=0
	for vbios_version_line in "${vbios_version_lines[@]}"; do
		#echo "Get GPU$i BIOS version"
		get_vbios_version=$(echo "$vbios_version_line" | grep -Eo '[0-9]*\.[0-9]*\.[0-9]*\.[0-9]*')
		get_kmd_version=$(echo "${kmd_version_lines[$i]}" | grep -Eo '[0-9]*\.[0-9]*\.[0-9]*')
		if [[ $get_vbios_version == $vbios_version ]] && [[ $get_kmd_version == $kmd_version ]]; then
				echo "The GPU$i BIOS and KMD version are compatible with the MACA version."
				a=$(($a+1))
		else
			if [[ $get_vbios_version != $vbios_version ]]; then
				echo "Warning: The GPU$i BIOS are NOT compatible with the MACA Version!"
				echo "		 (The running BIOS $get_vbios_version are NOT compatible with expected BIOS $vbios_version)"
			fi
			if [[ $get_kmd_version != $kmd_version ]]; then
				echo "Warning: The GPU$i KMD $get_kmd_version version are NOT compatible with the MACA Version!"
				echo "		 (The running KMD $get_kmd_version are NOT compatible with expected KMD $kmd_version)"
			fi
		fi
		i=$(($i+1))
	done

	## check compiler version
	if [[ $system_version == $mxgpu_llvm_version ]] ; then
		echo "The MACA compiler version is compatible with the MACA version."
	else
		echo "Warning: The MACA compiler is NOT compatible with the MACA Version!"
		echo "		 (The running MACA compiler $mxgpu_llvm_version is NOT compatible with expected compiler $system_version)"
	fi
	## check the version for UMD and other module
	for other_version_all_line in "${other_version_arr[@]}"; do
		if [[ $other_version_all_line != *$system_version* ]]; then
			echo "The $other_version_all_line is NOT compatible with expected system version $system_version"
		fi
	done
	if [[ $i == $a ]]; then
		break 7
	fi

	#echo "##########################"
	#echo "#### Sleep 10 minutes ####"
	#echo "##########################"
	sleep 600
	echo -e "\n"
done
